✅ **任务已完成！** 文件 `index.html` 已成功创建并保存到工作根目录。

以下是该 HTML 页面的亮点概览：

### 📄 页面结构

| 区域 | 内容 |
|------|------|
| **Hero 区域** | 系统标题、标语、动态徽章、CTA 按钮 |
| **架构概览** | 三层架构示意图（主智能体 → 子智能体 → 基类），带箭头连接 |
| **核心组件** | 三张卡片分别介绍 Agent04、SubAgent、ZQAgent，包含工具标签和特性列表 |
| **工作流程** | 四步流程图：任务接收→待办管理→执行策略→进度跟踪 |
| **工具列表** | 表格展示 8 个工具的名称、描述和归属（主/子/通用） |
| **技术亮点** | 8 个亮点卡片，覆盖 Java 21、Claude SDK、会话持久化、ripgrep 等 |

### 🎨 设计特性

- **深色科技风主题**，蓝色/紫色渐变主色调
- **响应式设计**，适配桌面端和移动端
- **滚动淡入动画**（IntersectionObserver）
- **平滑滚动导航**，带固定导航栏
- **悬停动效**：卡片上浮、边框发光、标签高亮
- **背景辐射光晕**，增强视觉层次感
- 控制台有隐藏彩蛋 🎉

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>HoppinAI Agent 04 - 主智能体+子智能体模块</title>
    <style>
        /* ===== CSS Reset & 基础设置 ===== */
        *,
        *::before,
        *::after {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        :root {
            --bg-primary: #0b0e1a;
            --bg-secondary: #111628;
            --bg-card: #161d35;
            --bg-card-hover: #1c2550;
            --border-color: #2a3560;
            --border-glow: #4f7aff;
            --text-primary: #e8edff;
            --text-secondary: #9aa8d4;
            --text-muted: #6a7ab5;
            --accent-blue: #4f7aff;
            --accent-cyan: #00d4ff;
            --accent-purple: #8b5cf6;
            --accent-green: #34d399;
            --accent-orange: #fb923c;
            --accent-pink: #f472b6;
            --accent-red: #ef4444;
            --shadow-card: 0 8px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
            --radius-sm: 8px;
            --radius-md: 16px;
            --radius-lg: 24px;
            --transition: 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
        }

        html {
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
        }

        body {
            font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC',
                'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            line-height: 1.7;
            min-height: 100vh;
            overflow-x: hidden;
        }

        /* ===== 背景粒子效果 ===== */
        body::before {
            content: '';
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            bottom: 0;
            background:
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 50%, rgba(79, 122, 255, 0.06) 0%, transparent 50%),
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 20%, rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.06) 0%, transparent 50%),
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 80%, rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.04) 0%, transparent 50%);
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 0;
        }

        /* ===== 滚动条 ===== */
        ::-webkit-scrollbar {
            width: 8px;
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
            background: var(--bg-secondary);
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
            background: var(--border-color);
            border-radius: 4px;
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
            background: var(--accent-blue);
        }

        /* ===== 容器 ===== */
        .container {
            max-width: 1200px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            padding: 0 24px;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        /* ===== 导航栏 ===== */
        .navbar {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            z-index: 100;
            background: rgba(11, 14, 26, 0.85);
            backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(42, 53, 96, 0.4);
            padding: 0 24px;
            height: 64px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .navbar .container {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            width: 100%;
        }

        .navbar-brand {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
            font-size: 18px;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            text-decoration: none;
        }

        .navbar-brand .logo-icon {
            width: 36px;
            height: 36px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent-blue), var(--accent-purple));
            border-radius: 10px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 18px;
            font-weight: 800;
            color: #fff;
        }

        .navbar-links {
            display: flex;
            gap: 8px;
            list-style: none;
        }

        .navbar-links a {
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            text-decoration: none;
            font-size: 14px;
            padding: 6px 16px;
            border-radius: 20px;
            transition: var(--transition);
        }

        .navbar-links a:hover {
            color: var(--text-primary);
            background: rgba(79, 122, 255, 0.1);
        }

        /* ===== Hero 区域 ===== */
        .hero {
            padding: 140px 0 80px;
            text-align: center;
            position: relative;
        }

        .hero-badge {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            background: rgba(79, 122, 255, 0.12);
            border: 1px solid rgba(79, 122, 255, 0.25);
            border-radius: 20px;
            padding: 6px 18px;
            font-size: 13px;
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
            margin-bottom: 24px;
            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
        }

        .hero-badge .dot {
            width: 8px;
            height: 8px;
            background: var(--accent-cyan);
            border-radius: 50%;
            animation: pulse-dot 2s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        @keyframes pulse-dot {
            0%,
            100% {
                opacity: 1;
                transform: scale(1);
            }
            50% {
                opacity: 0.5;
                transform: scale(0.8);
            }
        }

        .hero h1 {
            font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 4.2rem);
            font-weight: 800;
            line-height: 1.15;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e8edff 0%, #4f7aff 50%, #00d4ff 100%);
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            background-clip: text;
        }

        .hero p {
            font-size: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.2rem);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            max-width: 720px;
            margin: 0 auto 32px;
        }

        .hero-actions {
            display: flex;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 12px;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .btn {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            padding: 12px 28px;
            border-radius: 12px;
            font-size: 15px;
            font-weight: 600;
            text-decoration: none;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: var(--transition);
            border: none;
        }

        .btn-primary {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent-blue), var(--accent-purple));
            color: #fff;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(79, 122, 255, 0.3);
        }

        .btn-primary:hover {
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(79, 122, 255, 0.4);
        }

        .btn-outline {
            background: transparent;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
        }

        .btn-outline:hover {
            border-color: var(--accent-blue);
            background: rgba(79, 122, 255, 0.08);
            transform: translateY(-2px);
        }

        /* ===== 通用 section 标题 ===== */
        .section-title {
            text-align: center;
            margin-bottom: 56px;
        }

        .section-title .label {
            display: inline-block;
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
            margin-bottom: 12px;
        }

        .section-title h2 {
            font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 3.5vw, 2.6rem);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            margin-bottom: 12px;
        }

        .section-title p {
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            max-width: 600px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            font-size: 15px;
        }

        /* ===== Section 通用 ===== */
        section {
            padding: 80px 0;
        }

        /* ===== 架构概览 ===== */
        .architecture-overview {
            background: var(--bg-secondary);
            border-top: 1px solid rgba(42, 53, 96, 0.3);
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(42, 53, 96, 0.3);
        }

        .arch-diagram {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 20px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            padding: 20px 0;
        }

        .arch-node {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            border-radius: var(--radius-md);
            padding: 28px 32px;
            min-width: 200px;
            text-align: center;
            transition: var(--transition);
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .arch-node::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            height: 3px;
            border-radius: var(--radius-md) var(--radius-md) 0 0;
        }

        .arch-node.main::before {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-blue), var(--accent-purple));
        }
        .arch-node.sub::before {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-green), var(--accent-cyan));
        }
        .arch-node.base::before {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-orange), var(--accent-pink));
        }

        .arch-node:hover {
            border-color: var(--border-glow);
            transform: translateY(-4px);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
        }

        .arch-node .icon {
            font-size: 36px;
            margin-bottom: 12px;
        }

        .arch-node h3 {
            font-size: 18px;
            font-weight: 700;
            margin-bottom: 6px;
        }

        .arch-node .role {
            font-size: 13px;
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }

        .arch-node.main h3 {
            color: var(--accent-blue);
        }
        .arch-node.sub h3 {
            color: var(--accent-green);
        }
        .arch-node.base h3 {
            color: var(--accent-orange);
        }

        .arch-arrow {
            font-size: 28px;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            padding: 0 4px;
        }

        .arch-arrow .arrow-down {
            display: none;
        }

        /* ===== 核心组件 ===== */
        .components-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(340px, 1fr));
            gap: 24px;
        }

        .component-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            border-radius: var(--radius-md);
            padding: 32px;
            transition: var(--transition);
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .component-card::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            height: 3px;
            border-radius: var(--radius-md) var(--radius-md) 0 0;
        }

        .component-card:nth-child(1)::after {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-blue), var(--accent-purple));
        }
        .component-card:nth-child(2)::after {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-green), var(--accent-cyan));
        }
        .component-card:nth-child(3)::after {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-orange), var(--accent-pink));
        }

        .component-card:hover {
            border-color: var(--border-glow);
            transform: translateY(-4px);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
            background: var(--bg-card-hover);
        }

        .component-card .card-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 16px;
            margin-bottom: 16px;
        }

        .component-card .card-icon {
            width: 48px;
            height: 48px;
            border-radius: 14px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 24px;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .component-card:nth-child(1) .card-icon {
            background: rgba(79, 122, 255, 0.15);
        }
        .component-card:nth-child(2) .card-icon {
            background: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.15);
        }
        .component-card:nth-child(3) .card-icon {
            background: rgba(251, 146, 60, 0.15);
        }

        .component-card .card-title {
            font-size: 20px;
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .component-card:nth-child(1) .card-title {
            color: var(--accent-blue);
        }
        .component-card:nth-child(2) .card-title {
            color: var(--accent-green);
        }
        .component-card:nth-child(3) .card-title {
            color: var(--accent-orange);
        }

        .component-card .card-subtitle {
            font-size: 13px;
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }

        .component-card .card-desc {
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-size: 14px;
            margin-bottom: 16px;
        }

        .component-card .tool-list {
            display: flex;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 8px;
            margin-top: 12px;
        }

        .tool-tag {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
            background: rgba(79, 122, 255, 0.08);
            border: 1px solid rgba(79, 122, 255, 0.15);
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: 4px 12px;
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-family: 'SF Mono', 'Fira Code', 'Consolas', monospace;
            transition: var(--transition);
        }

        .tool-tag:hover {
            border-color: var(--accent-blue);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            background: rgba(79, 122, 255, 0.15);
        }

        .tool-tag .tag-icon {
            font-size: 10px;
        }

        .feature-dots {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 8px;
            margin-top: 16px;
        }

        .feature-dots li {
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-start;
            gap: 10px;
            font-size: 14px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            list-style: none;
        }

        .feature-dots li .dot-icon {
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
            flex-shrink: 0;
            margin-top: 3px;
        }

        /* ===== 工作流程 ===== */
        .workflow {
            background: var(--bg-secondary);
            border-top: 1px solid rgba(42, 53, 96, 0.3);
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(42, 53, 96, 0.3);
        }

        .workflow-steps {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr));
            gap: 24px;
            counter-reset: step;
        }

        .step-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            border-radius: var(--radius-md);
            padding: 32px 24px;
            text-align: center;
            transition: var(--transition);
            position: relative;
            counter-increment: step;
        }

        .step-card:hover {
            border-color: var(--border-glow);
            transform: translateY(-4px);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
        }

        .step-number {
            width: 48px;
            height: 48px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent-blue), var(--accent-purple));
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 18px;
            font-weight: 800;
            color: #fff;
            margin: 0 auto 16px;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(79, 122, 255, 0.3);
        }

        .step-card h3 {
            font-size: 18px;
            font-weight: 700;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }

        .step-card p {
            font-size: 14px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .step-card .step-icon {
            font-size: 28px;
            margin-bottom: 12px;
        }

        /* ===== 工具列表 ===== */
        .tools-table-wrap {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            border-radius: var(--radius-md);
            overflow: hidden;
            transition: var(--transition);
        }

        .tools-table-wrap:hover {
            border-color: var(--border-glow);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
        }

        .tools-table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: collapse;
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        .tools-table thead {
            background: rgba(79, 122, 255, 0.08);
        }

        .tools-table th {
            padding: 16px 20px;
            text-align: left;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            font-size: 13px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
        }

        .tools-table td {
            padding: 14px 20px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(42, 53, 96, 0.3);
        }

        .tools-table tr:last-child td {
            border-bottom: none;
        }

        .tools-table tr:hover td {
            background: rgba(79, 122, 255, 0.04);
        }

        .tools-table .tool-name {
            font-family: 'SF Mono', 'Fira Code', 'Consolas', monospace;
            color: var(--accent-blue);
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .tools-table .tool-for {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 4px;
            font-size: 12px;
            padding: 2px 10px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            background: rgba(79, 122, 255, 0.1);
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
        }

        .tools-table .tool-for.main {
            background: rgba(79, 122, 255, 0.12);
            color: var(--accent-blue);
        }
        .tools-table .tool-for.sub {
            background: rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.12);
            color: var(--accent-green);
        }
        .tools-table .tool-for.both {
            background: rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.12);
            color: var(--accent-purple);
        }

        /* ===== 技术亮点 ===== */
        .highlights-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr));
            gap: 20px;
        }

        .highlight-item {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            padding: 24px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-start;
            gap: 16px;
            transition: var(--transition);
        }

        .highlight-item:hover {
            border-color: var(--border-glow);
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
            background: var(--bg-card-hover);
        }

        .highlight-item .hl-icon {
            font-size: 28px;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            width: 44px;
            height: 44px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            background: rgba(79, 122, 255, 0.08);
            border-radius: 10px;
        }

        .highlight-item .hl-content h4 {
            font-size: 16px;
            font-weight: 600;
            margin-bottom: 4px;
        }

        .highlight-item .hl-content p {
            font-size: 13px;
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }

        /* ===== 底部 ===== */
        footer {
            border-top: 1px solid rgba(42, 53, 96, 0.3);
            padding: 40px 0;
            text-align: center;
        }

        footer p {
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-size: 13px;
        }

        footer .footer-links {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 24px;
            margin-bottom: 16px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        footer .footer-links a {
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            text-decoration: none;
            font-size: 13px;
            transition: var(--transition);
        }

        footer .footer-links a:hover {

                    });
